- Use the preinstalled `playwright-cli` executable from Actions or SSH.

- Run `playwright-cli open http://localhost:3002` for the Pascal development server.

413: function updateExtraction(dt) {
414:   if (!extraction.active) return
415:   extraction.elapsed += dt
416:   const progress = Math.min(1, extraction.elapsed / extraction.duration)
417:   const remaining = Math.max(0, extraction.duration - extraction.elapsed)
418:   const padDist = Math.hypot(player.position.x, player.position.z - 22.1)
419: 
420:   if (padDist > 7.2) {
421:     cancelExtraction('You left the extraction zone.')
422:     return
423:   }
424:   if (progress >= 1) {
425:     extraction.active = false
426:     world.setExtractionActive(false)
427:     ui.setExtraction(false)
428:     completeMission()
429:     return
430:   }
431:   ui.setExtraction(true, progress, remaining)
432:   const sec = Math.ceil(remaining)
433:   if (sec !== extraction.lastTick) {
434:     extraction.lastTick = sec
435:     audio.tick(sec <= 3)
436:   }
437:   if (extraction.elapsed > 3.2 && !extraction.alerted) {
438:     extraction.alerted = true
439:     let nearest = null
440:     let best = Infinity
441:     for (const r of robots) {
442:       const d = Math.hypot(r.position.x, r.position.z - 22.1)
443:       if (d < best) { best = d; nearest = r }
444:     }
445:     if (nearest) {
446:       nearest.alertTo({ x: 0, z: 22.1 }, true)
447:       ui.toast('SECURITY ALERT', 'A unit is moving toward the extraction pad', 'warn', 3600)
448:     }
449:   }
450: }

733: const joyEl = ui.el['joystick']

736: function updateJoystick(clientX, clientY) {
737:   const rect = joyEl.getBoundingClientRect()
738:   const cx = rect.left + rect.width / 2
739:   const cy = rect.top + rect.height / 2
740:   const max = rect.width * 0.32
741:   let dx = clientX - cx
742:   let dy = clientY - cy
743:   const len = Math.hypot(dx, dy)
744:   if (len > max) { dx = dx / len * max; dy = dy / len * max }
745:   joystick.x = dx / max
746:   joystick.z = -dy / max
747:   joyStick.style.transform = `translate(${dx}px, ${dy}px)`
748:   joyEl.classList.add('active')
749: }

751: joyEl.addEventListener('pointerdown', (e) => {
752:   e.preventDefault()
753:   if (state !== 'playing') return
754:   joystick.pointerId = e.pointerId
755:   joyEl.setPointerCapture(e.pointerId)
756:   updateJoystick(e.clientX, e.clientY)
757: })
758: joyEl.addEventListener('pointermove', (e) => {
759:   if (joystick.pointerId !== e.pointerId) return
760:   e.preventDefault()
761:   updateJoystick(e.clientX, e.clientY)
762: })
763: function endJoystick(e) {
764:   if (joystick.pointerId !== e.pointerId) return
765:   joystick.pointerId = null
766:   joystick.x = 0
767:   joystick.z = 0
768:   joyStick.style.transform = 'translate(0px, 0px)'
769:   joyEl.classList.remove('active')
770: }
771: joyEl.addEventListener('pointerup', endJoystick)
772: joyEl.addEventListener('pointercancel', endJoystick)
773: joyEl.addEventListener('pointerleave', (e) => { if (joystick.pointerId === e.pointerId) endJoystick(e) })

The player is an exploration specialist sent to investigate an abandoned futuristic research outpost.
